name: com.shannak.cascade-roll
description: Cascading loot roll for any game: one Roll() call walks a weighted table tree (type -> item), with weights bent at roll time by your own modifiers (falloff, pity, gates) and hard rules (guaranteed drops). Pure C# core, optional ScriptableObject tables, every roll explains itself in a trace.

samples.description: The plain cascade: Chest -> rarity (Common/Uncommon/Rare/Epic/Legendary by weight) -> item, no modifiers, no rules. Read this first.
Middle step: Chain on rarity, real weights inside each tier, and one modifier that raises Epic/Legendary odds per dry chest.
A ledger-driven falloff modifier (item and type), a guaranteed first drop, in-haul duplicate damping, and the trace printed to the console.
